name: @oplier/amm-execution
description: Part F — AMM routing & execution against Part K's self-deployed Uniswap V2-style AMM on X Layer testnet.

notes.no-viem-runtime-dependency: This package is written with zero runtime dependency on viem/ethers so it can be built and unit-tested (node:test + tsx) in a sandbox with no package-registry access. Calldata encoding (execution/calldata-encoder.ts) and log decoding (reconciliation/reconcile.ts) are injected seams — apps/worker wires viem's encodeFunctionData/decodeEventLog against this package's exported ABIs (src/abi/*) for the real implementation. This is a deliberate, flagged design decision, not an oversight — see README.md.
